Tara Singh  
Email: tarasingh@email.com | Phone: (555) 123-4567 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/tarasingh | Location: Austin, TX  

A results-oriented QA/Test Engineer with 2 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, specializing in test automation, API validation, and security protocol analysis. Proven ability to design robust test frameworks, integrate CI/CD pipelines, and contribute to secure software development practices. Committed to delivering high-quality, reliable systems through meticulous testing and collaboration.  

**Professional Experience**  
*QA Intern*  
SecureNet Cybersecurity Solutions | Austin, TX | 2022  
Supported the development of automated test suites for network security tools, focusing on API testing and security vulnerability validation. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to document test cases and ensure compliance with industry standards. Played a key role in refining test environments to improve coverage for edge-case scenarios.  

*QA Engineer*  
SecureNet Cybersecurity Solutions | Austin, TX | 2023  
Designed and executed test plans for encryption protocols, leveraging BDD frameworks to align testing with business requirements. Integrated CI/CD pipelines to automate regression testing, reducing manual effort by 30% for critical modules. Conducted security audits to identify and mitigate risks in third-party integrations.  

*Test Automation Engineer*  
SecureNet Cybersecurity Solutions | Austin, TX | 2024  
Led the development of a Python-based automation framework using Selenium and Playwright, streamlining test execution for web-based security tools. Optimized GitLab CI pipelines to parallelize test runs, decreasing deployment cycles by 25%. Spearheaded the implementation of TDD practices to improve code quality and maintainability.  

**Education**  
*Bachelor of Science in Computer Science*  
University of Technology | 2021  

**Technical Skills**  
- **Test Automation**: Built scalable frameworks for web and API testing, ensuring seamless integration with security validation workflows.  
- **API Testing**: Validated RESTful APIs for encryption tools, ensuring compliance with OWASP guidelines and data integrity standards.  
- **BDD/TDD**: Applied behavior-driven development to align test scenarios with stakeholder requirements, improving collaboration across teams.  
- **CI/CD Pipelines**: Automated deployment testing using GitLab CI, enhancing release efficiency and reducing post-deployment issues.  
- **Security Testing**: Conducted penetration testing and vulnerability assessments to strengthen the security posture of internal tools.  
- **Python**: Developed custom scripts for data analysis and test orchestration, improving reporting accuracy and test coverage.  
- **GitLab CI**: Integrated continuous testing into development workflows, ensuring rapid feedback loops for security-critical features.  

**Projects**  
*Automated Security Tool Validation Framework*  
Developed a Python-based framework using Selenium and Playwright to automate testing of network security tools, reducing manual test cycles by 40%. The solution included API validation for real-time threat detection modules.  

*CI/CD Integration for Encryption Suite*  
Designed and implemented GitLab CI pipelines to automate regression testing for an encryption suite, integrating with security scanners to ensure compliance with industry standards.  

*Behavior-Driven Testing for Compliance Tools*  
Created BDD test scenarios using Gherkin to validate compliance features in security tools, aligning testing efforts with regulatory requirements and improving stakeholder transparency.

English (fluent) | Python (proficient) | Bash (intermediate)
